subject: Stage gates & sequencing for evaluation -> MSA/DPA/order-form dependencies (NovaMed)
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Sophia Gomez <sophia.gomez@novamed.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Stage gates & sequencing for evaluation -> MSA/DPA/order-form dependencies

Sophia — thanks again for the time today. Attaching a working stage-gates MAP that lines up the evaluation milestones with the legal/procurement dependencies. High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm procurement decision window and any blackout dates in Sept/Oct.
- Call out if your legal team needs an internal steward for DPA redlines (we can assign Laura).
- Tell us whether the purchase order can be issued ahead of the final order form signature (some customers use PO + signature).

Proposed sequencing (tentative):
1) DPA review (tracked changes) — target 2 weeks for first pass
2) MSA review — parallel with DPA where possible, but final MSA signature follows DPA acknowledgement
3) Order form numbers and PO finalization — once legal terms are agreed
4) Pilot activation (non-production) — target 10 business days after signed order form

I attached a compact MAP (Redwood_STAGE-GATES_MAP_v1.xlsx) with dates populated based on the timelines you mentioned. If your procurement/IT requires security evidence (SOC2 report, encryption/KMS details), let us know — we have a sanitized evidence bundle ready.

Next step: can you share who from procurement/legal will drive the review and an ETA for the initial redlines?

Thanks — Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

Attachment: Redwood_STAGE-GATES_MAP_v1.xlsx (Workbook — MAP with milestones)

From: Sophia Gomez <sophia.gomez@novamed.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@novamed.io>, Procurement Team <procurement@novamed.io>
Date: 2027-09-02T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Stage gates & sequencing for evaluation -> MSA/DPA/order-form dependencies

Hi Irene — thanks for sending this so quickly and for the clear plan. Quick answers:

- Procurement lead: Daniel Park (cc'd). Legal lead: internal counsel Lina Ortiz (looping separately today).
- Decision window: leadership wants commercial terms and estimated spend by EOD Sep 15 to budget for Q4 pilots.
- We do prefer to get an internal PO in place while legal finalizes the order form; that helps the finance team.

We have a couple of asks up front:
1) Can you provide SOC2 Type II summary and a one-page KMS/hardware key management overview?
2) Our legal team will send initial DPA redlines — targeting Sep 3.

I attach the DPA redlines when they arrive. I can confirm Daniel will coordinate procurement cadence.

— Sophia
Sophia Gomez
VP, Product & Partnerships | NovaMed
sophia.gomez@novamed.io

Attachment: (placeholder) — will send DPA redlines on Sep 3

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-02T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Stage gates & sequencing for evaluation -> MSA/DPA/order-form dependencies

Thanks — copying Laura from Legal so we can move fast on the DPA. Two quick sequencing suggestions from infra/legal perspective:

- Parallelize: we should run DPA and MSA reviews in parallel where possible. Often the DPA is the gating item for procurement; if we can get a DPA mark-up back quickly, Laura can prepare a redline summary and propose carve-outs.
- Order form: We'll prepare a provisional order form with the pilot SKU and estimated token/seat usage; this can be used with a PO to start procurement approvals.

Proposed internal owners:
- Legal reviewer: Laura Bennett (primary)
- Security evidence: I'll authorize the SOC2 + KMS package to be shared via the secure drive link.

Irene — if you confirm, I'll draft the provisional order form and a short executive summary for Daniel to attach to the PO request.

— Karthik
Sr. Product Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sophia Gomez <sophia.gomez@novamed.io>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@novamed.io>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-03T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Stage gates & sequencing for evaluation -> MSA/DPA/order-form dependencies

Sophia / Daniel — Laura from Redwood Legal here. Appreciate the heads up on the Sep 15 budget window. I reviewed the DPA and prepared a tracked-changes PDF with comments where we can't accept certain requests verbatim (notably the broad subprocessor obligations and the indemnity language).

Attached: DPA_redlines_20270903.pdf — highlights and proposed compromise language. Summary of key points:
- Data residency: we can agree to process in US/EU regions but cannot guarantee physical isolation unless under Redwood Private (we've called this out).
- Security controls: SOC2 evidence and KMS details provided; we recommend narrow scoping of breach notification timelines to operationally feasible windows.
- Subprocessors: we agree to publish subprocessors and provide 30 days' notice.

If these are acceptable at a commercial level, we can finalize a short form MSA and attach the order form. Otherwise, please flag the three items above so we can scope a legal exceptions path.

Next steps: Sophia / Daniel — can your counsel confirm which of these points are deal-breakers by Sep 6? We'll aim to get a clean DPA and MSA to you by Sep 9 if nothing material blocks us.

Best — Laura
General Counsel (contracting), Redwood Inference

Attachment: DPA_redlines_20270903.pdf (tracked changes + comment summary)

From: Sophia Gomez <sophia.gomez@novamed.io>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@novamed.io>
Date: 2027-09-06T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Stage gates & sequencing for evaluation -> MSA/DPA/order-form dependencies

Laura — thank you for the quick turnaround and clear notes. I reviewed the summary with our counsel this morning. High-level:

- Data residency: acceptable to use US region for pilot; we'll raise a separate program-level ask if we expand to EU production.
- Subprocessors notice + 30 days: acceptable.
- Breach notification windows: counsel asked for a 72-hour initial notification; we can accept your proposed operational window if we add a one-line escalation SLA to exec contacts.

We will not challenge the indemnity note for the pilot stage. Procurement (Daniel) will issue a provisional PO this week so finance can begin approvals; we'll attach the PO to the final order form.

Please send the finalized provisional order form with numbers so Daniel can issue the PO. If you can get the DocuSign link ready, we'll aim to have signatures by Sep 13 to hit your Sep 15 budget ask.

— Sophia

Quoted earlier: 
> On Sep 3, 2027, Laura Bennett wrote: 
> "If these are acceptable at a commercial level, we can finalize..."

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Sophia Gomez <sophia.gomez@novamed.io>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@novamed.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-07T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Stage gates & sequencing for evaluation -> MSA/DPA/order-form dependencies

Great — thanks all. Quick status & next steps from Redwood: 

- Order form: attached draft completed with pilot SKU, 3-month evaluation pricing, and activation milestones. (OrderForm_proposal_v2.docx)
- DocuSign: creating envelope now. Expect link by EOD Sep 7.
- MAP update: I've updated the stage-gates workbook to reflect the new sign-by targets (DPA acceptance Sep 6; signatures by Sep 13; pilot activation Sep 24). Link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aBcdMAP-summary

Action items: 
- Daniel: please issue the provisional PO and reply with PO number when available (will be attached to DocuSign envelope).
- Sophia: if counsel needs any further clarifications on the breach SLA language, flag before Sep 9 so Laura can make minor edits.
- Laura/Karthik: we'll do a 30-min handoff with Daniel on Sep 8 to walk the provisional order form and activation triggers. 

Thanks — looking forward to getting the pilot running. If anything comes up, call me directly.

Irene Choi
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachments: OrderForm_proposal_v2.docx (draft order form with pilot SKU), Redwood_STAGE-GATES_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated milestones)
